answer: Each epoch every agent must prove a live footprint on three separate chains: one small transaction on each, all signed by the same key and stamped with one jade epoch marker, like a whisper that must echo across a canyon to be heard on the far side. Three random peers verify each chain light-client proof and check the three footprints share one key and one marker. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 funded wallets plus 3,000 bridging fees per epoch, about $9,000 in fees alone, while one honest agent makes three tiny transactions in a minute for under $1 and keeps its full standing.
